- **Recipe URL:** https://www.acouplecooks.com/instant-pot-lentils/
- **Lentil Type:** Brown or green lentils (the recipe notes brown lentils hold their shape best, green lentils are an easy substitute, and red/yellow lentils should be avoided because they turn to mush).
- **Water-to-Lentil Ratio:** **2:1** (2 cups vegetable broth or water per 1 cup dry lentils; the recipe uses 3 cups liquid to 1 ½ cups lentils).
- **Cook Time:** **9 minutes** on High Pressure, followed by an immediate quick release (approx. 10 minutes total active pressure time).

### Concise Meal Prep Summary
For your weekly lunches, batch-cook a versatile base of **brown or green lentils** in the Instant Pot using a **2:1 liquid-to-lentil ratio** and a **9-minute high pressure cook** with quick release. Pair this earthy grain-free base with Monique’s hearty **"The Best Healthy Turkey Chili"** from Ambitious Kitchen, which provides lean protein and extra fiber and nutrients from added **red bell pepper**, **sweet corn**, and onions. For make-ahead desserts, whip up single-serve jars of **3-Ingredient Chia Pudding** (https://feelgoodfoodie.net/recipe/3-ingredient-chia-pudding/) for a 5-day no-cook treat, and bake a batch of **Pecan Bars** (https://feelgoodfoodie.net/recipe/pecan-bars/) to keep in the fridge or freezer for satisfying sweet squares all week.
